biography:
== Biography ==
James William O'Donnell was born in the City of London in 1859, the son of Jeremiah (Jerome) O'Donnell, a tailor from Ireland, and his wife Eliza.<ref name="birth1859">"England & Wales, Civil Registration Birth Index, 1837-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/8912/records/25344039 : accessed 18 November 2026), James William O'Donnell, Jul-Sep quarter 1859, City of London, vol. 1c, p. 76.</ref><ref name="cen1861">"1861 England Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/8767/records/5480522 : accessed 18 November 2026), St Benet, City of London, ED 9, schedule 52; TNA RG 9/227, folio 76, p. 9. Jeremiah O'Donnell (indexed "Samuel"), head, 26, tailor, born Ireland; Eliza, wife, 25, born Ireland; James W., son, 1, born St Benet, London.</ref> By 1870 the family had moved to Cambridge, Massachusetts.<ref name="cen1870">"1870 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/records/26847081 : accessed 18 November 2026), Cambridge Ward 4, Middlesex, Massachusetts, dwelling 82; NARA M593 roll 624, p. 591A. Jeremiah O'Donnell 35, Eliza 28, James W. 10 (born England), Michael J. 8 (born England), Jerome J. 2.</ref><ref name="cen1880">"1880 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/6742/records/15361280 : accessed 18 November 2026), 8 Davis St, Cambridge, Middlesex, Massachusetts, ED 431, p. 309A. Jeremiah O'Donnell, 45, widower, tailor, born Ireland; children James 19, Michael 18, Joseph 12, Julia 9, Francis 7, Lizzie 5.</ref>

On 21 September 1882 in Boston, James, then a brass finisher, married Susan T. Mullen, aged 21, who was born in Cambridge, the daughter of James and Catharine Mullen.<ref name="marr1882">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5J-1BC : accessed 18 November 2026), James W. O'Donnell and Susan T. Mullen, married 21 Sep 1882, Boston, entry 2849. Groom 23, brass finisher, born England, parents Jerome and Elizabeth; bride 21, born Cambridge, parents James and Catharine.</ref> Their son Joseph F. O'Donnell was born in 1891.<ref name="marr1920">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:23RL-DL1 : accessed 17 November 2026), Joseph F O'Donnell and Lillian J Currier, married 28 Jun 1920, Boston, Suffolk, Massachusetts; certificate 3586, page 276. Groom's parents James W O'Donnell and Susan Mullen; bride's parents Lawson W Currier and Hannah L Murphy.</ref>

James died on 14 June 1926 and was buried at St Joseph Cemetery, West Roxbury.<ref name="jwgrave">"Find a Grave Index", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6LXQ-YW8Q : accessed 18 November 2026), James William O'Donnell Sr, 1859 - 14 Jun 1926, burial West Roxbury, Suffolk, Massachusetts.</ref>

=== Research Notes ===
* His 1926 Massachusetts death certificate has not been seen; the death date comes from the Find a Grave index.
